$comment: SONAR MODULE (pack: sonar) — targets bizapps-sonar (schema __mj_BizAppsSonar). DEFINITIONS ONLY: Sonar's FactorCompiler compiles factors to SQL and computes scores live, so we ship the model + version + bands + related entities + factors + weights and let Sonar recompute scores/contributions/history after install (never pre-compute score rows). Each factor is EXECUTABLE: Declarative, a supported aggregation (Count/Recency) over a related entity linked by SourceRelatedEntityID, RelationshipPath '[]' so the compiler auto-resolves the FK path to the People anchor (all single-hop). Recency windows come from Factor.DateField (the real business date column) + a Rolling TimeWindow — correct on seeded data regardless of __mj_CreatedAt. Weights are DIFFERENTIATED and Additive (WeightedSum, Sonar's demo convention is per-factor weight ~1). Engagement = breadth + recency + depth of real participation; a declining member scores below an active one because the engine counts the member's actual rows. Slug 'morecheese-engagement'. Integration-grade: model owner is a platform-pack staff user, so INSTALL_ORDER puts sonar after platform.

model.name: Member Engagement Score
model.description: Composite engagement score for federation members — breadth, recency, and depth of participation across events, governance, learning, advocacy, surveys, certifications, and competitions. The retention early-warning dial, computed live by Sonar.

sonar.$bandNote: thresholds CALIBRATED to the live score distribution (Percentile normalization + missing→Zero produces a right-skewed composite ~0–58; these cutoffs spread the population ~44/23/27/5% across the four bands with the engaged personas in Stable/Engaged). Recalibrate if the factor set or weights change materially.

bands.label: At Risk
bands.description: Disengaged — renewal is in doubt without intervention.

bands.label: Engaged
bands.description: Highly engaged — advocates and volunteers live here.

sonar.$factorNote: aggregation Count except the Recency factor (days since last event; HigherIsBetter=false). dateField = the leaf entity's business date column, paired with a Rolling window; factors without a window are all-time. Sonar's MinMax normalizes each factor over the member population; WeightedSum with the per-factor weights below.

factors.name: Event Participation
factors.description: Events the member registered for in the last 12 months.

factors.name: Certifications
factors.description: Certifications the member has pursued or earned.

factors.name: Learning Activity
factors.description: Courses the member enrolled in over the last 12 months.

factors.name: Advocacy Participation
factors.description: Advocacy actions the member took over the last 24 months.

factors.name: Competition Entries
factors.description: Cheese competition entries the member has submitted.

factors.name: Event Recency
factors.description: How recently the member last attended an event (sooner is better).

factors.name: Survey Participation
factors.description: Surveys the member responded to over the last 24 months.
